equations_of_record: tectonics/docs/I01_PHYSICAL_CONTRACT.md and the method documents under sources; this record restates no equation as new authority, and its separation negative example is a refusal case, not a law
completion_semantics: No field in this record is a pass/fail flag and no combination of status values means complete. Even if every row were selected_bounded_evidence and every MC item closed, a generated planet would still need the I02-I11 implementation and plan cases A-K. I01 completion remains the plan's I01 finish rule plus review. Scientific acceptance, Diadem canon, commit and publication are separate decisions.
stale_wording_rule: Wording that presents a breakup certificate, a generated separation or initiation event, or a completed I01 is stale against this record. So is wording that presents a ladder extrapolation as a separation certificate or proven handoff bound, crustal disconnection as plate separation, or a supplied magma input as the melt-derived generated route.

freshness_vs_validity.freshness: register_status copies the classification in tectonics/evidence/current-evidence.json; current means the receipt bytes and its declared bindings matched when the register was checked. Digests are copied from the register, not recomputed. Verify with python -B tools/check_current_evidence.py.
freshness_vs_validity.validity: Every cited I01 receipt is a bounded control recording scientific_acceptance false or a PASS_BOUNDED_..._ONLY status. The B1 receipt is descriptive and the New World receipts are historical. None is generated-world, calibration or I01-completion evidence.
freshness_vs_validity.bound_by: bound_by names the current receipt whose top-level /source_sha256 lists the file. unbound means no current receipt binds it. This record binds nothing, and neither of its own two files is bound.

items.title: Through-lithosphere separation of plastic-dominated or brittle lithosphere: mechanism and elastic memory
items.reason: I01_PHYSICAL_CONTRACT section 8 requires an admitted through-lithosphere separation law. The necking chain refuses the retained column (REFUSED_REQUIRES_RESOLVED_NECK), and no admitted mechanism says when a resolved plastic or brittle field has separated: a universal fracture energy and magma-assisted breakup are refused, cutoffs are refused, and a truncated ladder cannot establish a finite limit (separation.negative_example). Retaining elastic memory is selected separately; it does not supply the missing separation mechanism.

elastic_memory_selection.requires: I02 persistence, I05 objective material transport, I07 general logarithmic constitutive implementation and creep/plastic/thermal coupling; no omission or separation authorised

items.closes_when: an admitted mechanism from separation.bounded_rate_argument, with equations, inputs, provenance, validity and tests, passes the predeclared I07 comparison of separation.outstanding_choices with retained elastic memory. A truncated ladder, manufactured field, accounting control or the chain's analytical feasibility cannot close it. If no mechanism passes it stays open; only the owner can reclassify the route as unsupported (INTEGRATION_PLAN section 5).

records.rule: Only an admitted through-lithosphere separation (I01_PHYSICAL_CONTRACT section 8) splits plate ownership, by the I01_TRANSITIONS section 3 split rule. Crustal disconnection may be recorded only as a separately named milestone; alone it neither removes connected mantle coupling nor splits ownership. This record does not change the contract.

negative_example.status: required refusal case for any separation logic
negative_example.field: h = H_c - u/c for u <= u_a = c (H_c - a w); h = a w exp(-(u - u_a)/(c a w)) for u > u_a; fixed physical length w > 0 (for example a width set by the D2 length ell), a > 0, c > 0, a w < H_c; slope continuous at u_a
negative_example.truth: at u = c H_c, h = a w/e > 0; h stays positive at every finite opening for every fixed w
negative_example.truncated_ladder: admit only rungs h_k = H_c 2^-k >= c_w w; if a <= c_w every admitted rung lies on the linear branch, u_k = c (H_c - h_k) and every increment ratio is exactly 1/2; given at least the five rungs its window needs, the I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 5 ratio rule (ratio_max 0.9, ratio_spread 0.02) reports FINITE_LIMIT, exponent 1 and the false limit c H_c; halving w leaves that limit unchanged
negative_example.required_outcome: refused: no event, finite-limit proof or handoff-error bound; the extrapolation may be reported only as a diagnostic

evidence_rules: A ladder extrapolation is a diagnostic, never a certificate or a proven handoff-error bound. The chain's status rests on the declared power law's exact asymptotics, which its ladder only corroborates (I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 5, obligations 1 and 3); a resolved field has no such asymptotics.

Grid refinement (N versus 2N) at a fixed physical regularisation length, the D2 ell, tests the numerical convergence of one physical model. Changing ell changes the physics (IN-04) and is reported as a sensitivity, never as refinement.
The shear-zone width and the geometric neck width are measured separately; neither is established as equal to the other or to ell.
Detection levels are reporting levels: a lower floor or level does not turn a diagnostic into an event, and no smaller cutoff may replace a refused one.
Every comparison reports the neck's stress, pressure, temperature and strain-rate ranges against declared coefficient support (I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 5, obligation 1).

bounded_rate_argument.status: Atlas reasoning; no source is claimed
bounded_rate_argument.statement: While the velocity gradient stays bounded, material moves by a continuous, invertible map, so a connected material set stays connected and its thickness stays at least its initial value times exp(-integral of the maximum strain-rate magnitude dt). The fixed-width neck of I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 2 and the negative example's exponential branch are special cases.
separation_needs_one_of: a finite-time singularity shown for the resolved solution from its declared laws' asymptotics, not from a ladder
an admitted change of state or composition, such as melting with extraction
an admitted failure law that creates a discontinuity
